info.name: RTR Pipeline Engine Service
info.description:
API collection for RTR Pipeline Engine Service with JWT authentication and tenant-based access control.

## Authentication
- All endpoints require JWT authentication via Authorization header
- All endpoints require X-Tenant-ID header
- Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per IP + Tenant combination

## Roles
- ADMIN: Full access to all endpoints
- HR: Can create, list, and assign pipelines
- INTERVIEWER: Read-only access to list pipelines

item.name: Pipeline Management

header.description: Tenant ID (must match JWT tenant claim)

request.description:
Creates a new pipeline for the tenant.

**Required Role:** ADMIN or HR

**Request Body:**
- `name` (string, required): Pipeline name (3-255 characters)
- `description` (string, optional): Pipeline description (max 1000 characters)
- `stages` (array, required): Array of stage objects (1-10 stages)
  - `stage` (string, required): Stage name (1-100 characters)
  - `type` (string, required): One of: phone, technical, system_design, behavioral, offer
- `extra` (object, optional): Custom tenant-specific fields

**Response:** 200 OK with created pipeline object

header.description: Tenant ID (must match JWT tenant claim)

request.description:
Retrieves all pipelines for the tenant.

**Required Role:** ADMIN, HR, or INTERVIEWER (read-only)

**Response:** 200 OK with array of pipeline objects

header.description: Tenant ID (must match JWT tenant claim)

request.description:
Assigns a pipeline to a specific job.

**Required Role:** ADMIN or HR

**Request Body:**
- `pipeline_id` (string, required): UUID of the pipeline to assign
- `job_id` (string, required): UUID of the job to assign the pipeline to

**Response:** 201 Created with success message
